Hive Vault Arc is a technology transformation partner based in Tangier, Morocco. The company combines strategy and business consulting, technology consulting, AI and data engineering, custom software development, cloud infrastructure, and managed operations across the full lifecycle from discovery to production.

The company is not positioned as an advice-only consultancy or a build-only development agency. It is a founder-led team that diagnoses operating constraints, designs the target system, builds the software and automation, and stays involved after launch.

## 2. Brand Naming Rules

- Use "Hive Vault Arc" in normal sentence copy.
- Use "HIVE VAULT ARC" only for uppercase brand labels, lockups, or design contexts.
- Use "H.V.A" and "HVA" as search aliases, compact references, and metadata alternate names.
- Do not make H.V.A or HVA the primary public-facing company name in prose.

## 3. Leadership

Hive Vault Arc is led by three co-founders. Each founder is a CEO and owns a distinct responsibility area.

- Khalid Chalhi: Co-Founder and CEO. Responsible for strategy, AI engineering, and software execution.
- Ali Amrani: Co-Founder and CEO. Responsible for product systems, full-stack engineering, and delivery architecture.
- Oubay Ghamat: Co-Founder and CEO. Responsible for cloud infrastructure, operations, and production reliability.

## 4. ARC Delivery Model

Hive Vault Arc's signature model is ARC: Assess, Re-engineer, and Command.

### Assess

Assess maps the current operating state, system inventory, constraints, risks, and highest-leverage transformation opportunities. It connects business priorities with architecture decisions before build work begins.

Typical Assess outputs:

- Operating model review
- System and data inventory
- Process and workflow diagnosis
- Transformation roadmap
- Risk and dependency map
- KPI and decision framework

### Re-engineer

Re-engineer redesigns the process model, target architecture, AI system design, integration strategy, product workflow, and delivery sequence.

Typical Re-engineer outputs:

- AI agent design
- Software architecture
- Cloud architecture
- CRM and workflow design
- Data model and reporting logic
- Integration blueprint
- Implementation backlog

### Command

Command builds, deploys, stabilizes, operates, and continuously improves the production system after go-live.

Typical Command outputs:

- Production deployment
- Managed operations
- Observability and reporting
- Support workflows
- Continuous optimization
- Reliability and incident handling

Production AI agents, generative AI engineering, data engineering, business intelligence, predictive analytics, multilingual conversational AI, MLOps, and AI operations.

Custom software, SaaS platforms, enterprise systems, web applications, mobile applications, API development, integration engineering, DevOps, and production-grade frontend systems.

Cloud migration, cloud-native architecture, infrastructure automation, security architecture, observability, disaster recovery, CI/CD, and reliability engineering.

### Operations and Managed Services

Managed operations, application maintenance, automation operations, AI system management, business process support, operational reporting, and continuous improvement.

## 9. Case Studies

### Multilingual WhatsApp AI Agent for Lead Operations

- URL: https://hivevaultarc.com/case-studies/multilingual-whatsapp-ai-agent
- Client: Atlas Property Group
- Industry: Real Estate
- Status: Live in production since October 2025

Problem: inbound leads were handled manually across WhatsApp and phone. The client was losing after-hours opportunities and spending sales capacity on repetitive triage.

Solution: a production AI WhatsApp agent with persistent memory, automated scheduling, lead qualification, and real-time CRM pipeline updates.

Architecture: event-driven AI orchestration with multilingual NLU, memory store, intent routing, and escalation policies for human takeover.

Integrations: WhatsApp Business API, HubSpot, Google Calendar, n8n workflow runner, PostgreSQL, FastAPI, Next.js, and Socket.IO.

Measured outcomes:

- First response latency: less than 18 seconds
- Manual triage reduction: 85%
- Qualified meetings booked: +43%

### Zoho-Grade CRM Transformation Program

- URL: https://hivevaultarc.com/case-studies/zoho-grade-crm-platform
- Client: Capstone Living Morocco
- Industry: Real Estate
- Status: Live in production since May 2025

Problem: disconnected tools created duplicate data, missed follow-ups, and no reliable reporting layer for leadership decisions.

Solution: a full CRM operating system with pipeline stages, role-based workflows, audit trails, and automated follow-up orchestration.

Architecture: modular CRM architecture with domain-driven entities, workflow engine, event logs, and per-department permissions.

Integrations: Meta Ads Lead Sync, HubSpot migration bridge, DocuSign, Twilio, Power BI, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL.

Measured outcomes:

- Pipeline visibility: 100%
- Manual data-entry time: -40%
- Tracked deal volume: $2.4M per month

## 10. AI Agent Architecture

Hive Vault Arc's typical AI agent architecture uses an event-driven orchestration pattern.

1. Channel layer: WhatsApp Business API, web chat, voice, and email.
2. Intent and NLU layer: multilingual intent classification, entity extraction, and language detection.
3. Memory layer: persistent customer and conversation context backed by structured storage.
4. Orchestration layer: n8n workflows or custom FastAPI services to route events and trigger actions.
5. Integration layer: HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Calendar, DocuSign, Twilio, Meta Ads, Power BI, and custom APIs.
6. Escalation layer: human takeover policies, agent assist mode, and audit trails.
7. Observability layer: latency monitoring, structured logs, accuracy sampling, and operations dashboards.

Common stack:

- Frontend: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Backend: FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Socket.IO
- Automation: n8n, custom workflow engines, webhooks
- Infrastructure: Vercel, cloud-native deployment, managed databases, CI/CD
- Integrations: WhatsApp Business API, HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Calendar, Twilio, Power BI

## 11. Market Context

Hive Vault Arc focuses on Morocco, France, Europe, North Africa, and MENA. Its local base in Tangier is relevant because Tangier connects Moroccan operations, nearshore delivery, logistics, and Morocco-France business flows.

Important market signals:

- WhatsApp is a dominant business communication channel in Morocco.
- Moroccan companies often need multilingual systems that support Arabic, French, English, and sometimes Spanish.
- Many SMEs still run important workflows on spreadsheets, phone calls, WhatsApp, and disconnected tools.
- Real Estate, Healthcare, Logistics, Tourism, Manufacturing, and Services are strong candidates for AI automation and workflow modernization.
- European and French companies with Morocco operations need reliable bilingual or multilingual technology partners.

## 12. Differentiators

- End-to-end accountability: one team owns strategy, engineering, and operations.
- Founder-led delivery: senior technical and strategic owners stay close to the work.
- Production proof: public case studies are live deployments with measured outcomes.
- Multilingual-native delivery: English, French, Arabic, and Spanish are part of the operating context.
- Long-horizon partnership: managed evolution after launch is part of the model.
- Discovery-first scoping: scope is shaped after strategic and technical diagnosis.

## 13. Commercial Approach

- Pricing is private and discussed after discovery.
- Discovery happens before formal scoping.
- Scope depends on transformation complexity, AI system requirements, integrations, delivery horizon, and maintenance needs.
- NDAs can be used before sensitive system, data, or commercial details are discussed.
- Build-Operate-Transfer can be used when a client wants staged capability transfer.

## 16. Frequently Asked Questions

### What does Hive Vault Arc do?

Hive Vault Arc is a technology transformation partner based in Tangier, Morocco. It combines strategy consulting, technology consulting, AI engineering, data services, custom software development, cloud infrastructure, and managed operations from discovery through production.

### Who leads Hive Vault Arc?

Hive Vault Arc is led by three Co-Founders and CEOs: Khalid Chalhi, Ali Amrani, and Oubay Ghamat. Khalid owns strategy, AI, and software execution; Ali owns product systems and full-stack delivery architecture; Oubay owns cloud infrastructure, operations, and reliability.

### What is the ARC model?

ARC means Assess, Re-engineer, and Command. Hive Vault Arc uses this model to diagnose operating constraints, rebuild systems and workflows, and stay involved after launch so the transformation runs in production.

### Where is Hive Vault Arc located?

Hive Vault Arc is based in Tangier, Morocco. It serves clients across Morocco and international markets, especially France, Europe, North Africa, MENA, and remote delivery contexts.

### What digital services does Hive Vault Arc provide in Tangier?

Hive Vault Arc provides AI agents and WhatsApp automation, IT consulting, technology strategy, custom software, SaaS development, CRM engineering, digital transformation programs, cloud infrastructure, and managed operations.

### Is H.V.A the same company as Hive Vault Arc?

Yes. H.V.A and HVA are search aliases and short references for Hive Vault Arc. The preferred public company name is Hive Vault Arc.

### What is Hive Vault Arc's WhatsApp AI agent?

It is a custom AI agent deployed through WhatsApp Business API to handle lead qualification, customer support, scheduling, sales automation, CRM updates, and human escalation. The Atlas Property Group deployment operates 24/7 and reduced manual triage by 85%.

### What technologies does Hive Vault Arc use?

Common technologies include Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, n8n, AI agent runtimes, WhatsApp Business API, HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Calendar, DocuSign, Twilio, Power BI, Vercel, and cloud-native infrastructure.
